name: Sculpfun S30 Ultra 22W
tagline: Middle S30 Ultra head: strong diode cutting, one step below the 33W
tldr: The 22W is the middle of Sculpfun's three S30 Ultra heads (11W, 22W, 33W), often sold bundled with LightBurn. The 33W head goes further for thick cuts. Listings that say S30 Ultra 10W or 20W are reseller labels.

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Kit includes a 24V automatic air pump: cutting is ready out of the box
Fastest cut speeds of the S30 Ultra profiles we list: up to ~14 mm/s on 3–6 mm wood
Fills at ~80–160 mm/s for quick batches of signs and tags

editorialDepth.advantages: Sculpfun S30 Ultra 22W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks: fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame: safety and smoke are on you.

cons: $690 with LightBurn is a big step over the entry head for engraving-only buyers
Fire risk rises on long cutting runs: never leave a job unattended
Wider ~0.08 mm spot than the entry head, slightly softer on tiny text
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 22W SKU on Sculpfun S30 Ultra. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Tune cut passes with air assist and focus checks. For photo engraving, slow down vs your cut presets: this head is optimized for throughput on wood, not only finesse.
primaryUse: Cut-biased diode tier for makers who outgrew 10–20W job times but stay on the same frame
mainObjective: Faster cutting and deeper hobby cuts while keeping solid engraving capability

faq.question: What do I get for $690?
faq.answer: $689.99 is Sculpfun's price for the S30 Ultra 22W bundled with a LightBurn Core licence key; the machine alone was $539.99–569.99 on Sculpfun's store in October 2026. The kit lists a 24V automatic air pump, a laser shield and a laser repair kit, so it is ready to cut out of the box.

faq.question: How thick can the S30 Ultra 22W cut?
faq.answer: In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 4–7 min, with cut speeds up to ~14 mm/s on 3–6 mm wood. Around 8 mm basswood and 5 mm dark acrylic are realistic with air assist. Thicker stock is where the 33W head starts to make sense.

faq.question: 22W or the 33W S30 Ultra?
faq.answer: Sculpfun prices the 33W at $769.99 alone ($859.99 with LightBurn), about $230 more than the 22W machine. The 22W suits mixed engraving and cutting up to about 8 mm; the 33W is for daily thicker cutting. Our S30 Ultra 33W profile has its cutting figures.

standoutFeatures.title: Air pump in the box
standoutFeatures.body: Sculpfun's kit lists a 24V automatic air pump with the high-pressure metal nozzle, so cuts stay clean without extra purchases.

standoutFeatures.title: Strong diode cutting
standoutFeatures.body: 3 mm basswood squares in about 4–7 min in our benchmarks, with around 8 mm reachable in passes.

standoutFeatures.title: Room to grow
standoutFeatures.body: The 33W head (a $549.99 upgrade kit in October 2026) fits the same frame, adapter and cable if you outgrow the 22W.
